en.headline: Customs and firefighters dismantle illegal petrol station near Man Kam To homes
en.dek: Officers seized about 1,560 litres of duty-not-paid petrol and arrested a 33-year-old man after finding a fenced shed on Man Kam To Road.
body: Hong Kong Customs and the Fire Services Department dismantled an illegal petrol station near residential buildings in the Man Kam To area on Monday morning, seizing about 1,560 litres of duty-not-paid petrol with a market value of about HK$54,000 and a duty value of about HK$9,500.

Officers found a fenced metal shed on Man Kam To Road that emitted a strong petrol smell. A cross-border private car was transferring fuel at the site. The male driver tried to flee but was subdued and arrested. The 33-year-old Chinese national, who claimed to be a car dealership employee, was taken into custody.

Customs said the illegal station lacked compliant fire safety equipment and posed a major safety hazard because it was near homes. The car, petrol and equipment were seized. Customs will investigate the source of the petrol and handle the items under the Dutiable Commodities Ordinance. The departments urged the public not to patronise illegal petrol stations and to report suspected activities.

zh.headline: 海關消防搗破文錦渡民居附近非法加油站
zh.dek: 人員在文錦渡路檢獲約1560公升未完稅汽油，並拘捕一名33歲男子。
body: 香港海關聯同消防處周一早上在文錦渡民居附近搗破一處非法加油站，檢獲約1560公升未完稅汽油，市值約5.4萬元，應課稅值約9500元。
人員發現文錦渡路一有圍欄的金屬棚散發出強烈汽油味，並發現一輛跨境私家車正在入油。男司機企圖逃跑，但被制服及拘捕。該名33歲內地男子自稱在車行工作。
海關表示，非法油站缺乏合規消防設備，又近民居，構成嚴重安全隱患。涉案車輛、汽油及工具已被檢走。海關將調查汽油來源，並根據《應課稅品條例》處理。兩部門呼籲市民不要光顧非法油站，並舉報可疑活動。
